'''Cel Amiin''' was a remote [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] that defied [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] shortly after the formation of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. Like the other worlds that refused to cooperate, Cel Amiin suffered an unspecified devastation as a result.<ref name="IC 501st" />
